title: finding(AGENTS.md): mutation ③ (a second attribution footer appended) is scoped to `PATCH`, but a `POST` create shows the same 58-byte doubling signature
body:
Dedupe words: `attribution footer` · `duplicate footer` · GitHub body mutation · `POST` vs `PATCH` · AGENTS.md mutation ③

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9603 (PR objectui#9901) as an out-of-scope finding; the AGENTS.md text and the control below were **re-read at source by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat 3** before filing. ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ no `domain:*` applied, ⛔ not routed.

⚠️ `AGENTS.md` is a **governed surface**, so this is filed as a card for a maintainer-approved edit and ⛔ was **not** repaired seat-side.

## The declaration, read on `origin/main`

`AGENTS.md:475`, verbatim:

> **③ `PATCH` 无条件追加第二个 footer** —— 哪怕提交的正文已经以一个 footer 结尾。逐字节回读实测:存储的正文比发出的多**恰好 58 字节**,unified diff 只有那几行追加的 footer、没有内容被吃 ⇒ 与 ①② 都不同,这一种是**加**,不是**减**。

⇒ the section scopes that mutation to **`PATCH`**. A seat planning around it reads 「only PATCH does this」.

## The measurement that does not fit

⚠️ **This reading is the delivering dev's**, taken in its own act and reported as such; ⛔ this seat did not reproduce the doubling. On a **CREATE** — `POST /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9603/comments`, a body that already ended with a footer — the stored comment was **exactly 58 bytes longer than was sent** and ended with **two identical bare footers**. Same signature, same byte count, on the endpoint the text does not name.

⭐ **Lit control, and this one IS this seat's own**: every `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` write this shift reports the same `+58` on `POST` — e.g. 「read-back: clean — the platform appended its footer (sent 4021, stored 4079)」 — and those land with **one** footer, because that tool deliberately sends none (its own words: 「The attribution footer is the caller's … this tool adds none」). ⇒ the `+58` is the platform's append on any `POST`; what produces the **doubling** is sending a body that already carries one. That is mutation ③'s behaviour, and it is reachable without a single `PATCH`.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

This is the section a seat consults **precisely when deciding whether a read-back delta is damage**. A seat that has internalised 「only PATCH appends a second footer」 will read a `+58` on its own `POST` as the benign single append — which it usually is — and will not look for the doubled tail in the case where it is not.

⚠️ Note what is NOT owed here: the dev's own content was fully intact (its JSON re-parsed, every load-bearing string present), so under AGENTS.md's own 「⛔ 不要去修一个只是读起来不同的正文」 rule nothing was rewritten to repair it. The defect is in the **text's scope**, ⛔ not in any stored comment.

## ⛔ Not measured here, and named so the gap is not read as clean

Whether the doubling needs the sent footer to be the **bare** form specifically, whether `create_pull_request` behaves the same way (⑤ says it normalises bare → session-URL on that endpoint, which may interact), and whether the 58 bytes is stable across footer forms. The claiming seat should measure those before writing the amended sentence, so the repair states a rule rather than one instance.

⛔ Not deduped by this seat — the filer attaches the words and triage runs them.
